summary: 结束列国分立、建立中央集权帝制的秦帝国开创者。
summary_en: Founder of the Qin empire, who ended the division of the Warring States and established a centralized imperial system.

portrait.appearance_basis:
《史记》未系统描写五官细节。画像宜表现战国末至统一初期君主的威重、
深衣冠冕的时代特征，以及巡狩天下的倦锐并存气质。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 邯郸出生
timeline.summary: 生于邯郸，名政，庄襄王子。
timeline.summary_en: Born in Handan; named Zheng, a son of King Zhuangxiang.

timeline.title: 即位为秦王
timeline.summary: 年十三即位，国事委大臣，吕不韦为相。
timeline.summary_en: He came to the throne at thirteen; state affairs were entrusted to ministers, with Lü Buwei as chancellor.

timeline.title: 王冠亲政
timeline.summary: 王冠带剑；平嫪毐之乱，强化王权。
timeline.summary_en: He was capped and girded with the sword; he suppressed Lao Ai's revolt and strengthened royal authority.

timeline.title: 灭韩
timeline.summary: 灭六国战争展开，韩先亡。
timeline.summary_en: The wars to annex the six states unfolded; Han fell first.

timeline.title: 称始皇帝
timeline.summary: 并天下，号始皇帝，分三十六郡。
timeline.summary_en: He annexed All-under-Heaven, took the title First Emperor, and divided the realm into thirty-six commanderies.

timeline.title: 统一制度
timeline.summary: 书同文、车同轨等统一措施（择要）。
timeline.summary_en: Unification measures such as a common script and uniform axle widths (selected highlights).

timeline.title: 封禅泰山
timeline.title_en: Feng and Shan at Mount Tai
timeline.summary_en: Touring the eastern commanderies, he ascended Mount Tai and erected a stone stele.

timeline.title: 焚书
timeline.summary_en: Li Si proposed burning the Odes, the Documents, and the books of the hundred schools.

timeline.title: 坑术士
timeline.summary: 坑杀为妖言的诸生（对象/人数有争议）。
timeline.summary_en: Scholars accused of spreading sedition were buried alive (the targets and numbers are disputed).

timeline.title: 沙丘崩
timeline.summary: 出巡途中崩于沙丘平台。
timeline.summary_en: He died at the Shaqiu Platform while on tour.

timeline.title: 沙丘嗣位
timeline.summary_en: A forged edict installed Huhai; the Second Emperor took the throne.

timeline.title: 秦亡对照
timeline.summary_en: Ziying surrendered and Liu Bang entered the Pass (cross-page).

relations.note: 二世胡亥（史载继位过程充满权谋）
relations.note_en: Hu Hai, the Second Emperor (records say the succession was steeped in intrigue)

relations.note: 秦亡后刘邦建立汉朝（跨朝关联，叙事对照）
relations.note_en: After Qin falls, Liu Bang founds the Han dynasty (cross-dynasty narrative foil)

bio_md:
# 秦始皇 · 主要事迹

嬴政以秦王之身，承数世耕战与变法之积，完成对山东列国的次第吞并，于前二二一年称「始皇帝」。其意义不只在「打赢战争」，更在于把「皇帝 + 郡县 + 书同文车同轨」等制度，推到前所未有的规模。

统一之后，他频繁出巡（见年表与侧栏地图），东至海上，南至湘水，北临边塞，以身体力行宣示「天下一人」。封禅泰山、刻石颂功，是权力的仪式语言；同时，严刑峻法、大规模工程与思想控制，也使「秦政」成为后世争论不休的标本。

沙丘之变后，帝位落入[[qin-er-shi|秦二世]]，帝国迅速失稳。数年后，[[han-gao-zu|汉高祖]]刘邦所代表的新政治力量入主关中，秦的制度遗产却以更柔性的形式进入汉家天下。后世如[[han-wu-di|汉武帝]]的封禅与开边，亦可与此页长线对读。

> 参考：点校本《史记》、谭图第 2 册、纪年表。

bio_parts_en.value:
As king of Qin, Ying Zheng built on the military-agricultural strength and reforms accumulated over several reigns to annex, one after another, the states east of the mountains, and in 221 BC he took the title "First Emperor" (Shi Huangdi). His significance lies not merely in "winning the wars," but in pushing institutions such as "emperor + commanderies and counties + a unified script and uniform axle widths" to an unprecedented scale.

After unification he toured incessantly (see the timeline and the sidebar map): east to the sea, south to the Xiang River, north to the frontier walls, proclaiming by his own presence that there was "one man over All-under-Heaven." The Feng and Shan sacrifices at Mount Tai and the stone inscriptions extolling his merit were the ritual language of power; at the same time, severe laws, massive construction projects, and thought control made "Qin governance" an enduring object of debate for later ages.

After the coup at Shaqiu, the throne fell to

bio_parts_en.label: Qin Er Shi, the Second Emperor of Qin

bio_parts_en.value: , and the empire quickly lost stability. A few years later, the new political force represented by Liu Bang,
, took control of Guanzhong, yet Qin's institutional legacy entered the Han order in a more flexible form. The Feng and Shan rites and frontier expansion of later rulers such as

may also be read against this page over the long term.
